meta.name: internal-linking-optimizer
meta.description: Analyze site's internal link structure and optimize for hub-and-spoke SEO architecture. Triggers on: "optimize internal links", "internal linking", "link structure", "hub and spoke links", "orphan pages", "link equity", "internal link audit", "fix my internal links", "link architecture", "site structure optimization", "internal linking strategy", "link flow", "improve site structure", "find orphan pages", "maximize link equity", "internal link map".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网站内链结构，优化为轮辐式SEO架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营网站并希望提升内部链接权重和搜索引擎排名
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to improve internal link equity and search rankings.

howto.what: 分析网站内部链接结构，找出孤页和链接瓶颈，生成含锚文本、位置和优先级的链接添加指令，优化轮轴式SEO架构。
howto.when: 当你提到“优化内部链接”、“内部链接结构”、“孤页”等，或要求审计内部链接、改善网站结构时触发。

say.text: 审计我博客的内部链接
say.note: 发现孤页并生成添加链接建议

say.text: 我新发了一篇文章，应该链接哪些旧文？
say.note: 识别3-5个应链接到新文章的页面

say.text: 根据关键词集群优化内部链接
say.note: 使用集群结构定义理想链接架构

howto.what_en: Analyze site internal link structure, find orphan pages and bottlenecks, generate specific linking instructions with anchor text and placement to optimize hub-and-spoke SEO.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "optimize internal links", "internal linking", "orphan pages", or ask for a link audit or site structure improvement.

say_en.note: Finds orphan pages and generates link suggestions

say_en.text: I published a new article, what should link to it?
say_en.note: Identifies 3-5 existing pages to link to new article

say_en.text: Optimize internal links based on my keyword clusters
say_en.note: Uses cluster structure to define ideal link architecture
